root_cause.text: The `xfs_attr3_leaf_add_work` function failed to adjust freemap entries whose base addresses fell within the newly expanded range of the leaf entries array, causing the freemap to incorrectly claim space occupied by the entries.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the freemap adjustment loop to check `if (ichdr->freemap[i].base < new_end)` in addition to the existing check for `base == old_end`, ensuring that any freemap entry starting inside the new entries array boundary is shifted upward to prevent overlap.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes freemap entry adjustment logic when growing attribute leaf arrays to prevent corruption of free space tracking.
intent_record.what: Replaced single-variable calculation (tmp) with new_end/old_end variables for freemap adjustment. Changed from checking equality with tmp to handling two cases: freemap entry at old_end position, and freemap entry within newly claimed space. Updated type from xfs_attr_leaf_entry_t to struct xfs_attr_leaf_entry.
intent_record.how: Enables proper adjustment of freemap entries when the attribute leaf array grows. Previously only handled freemap entries starting exactly at the old end; now correctly handles entries that start within the newly allocated space by calculating appropriate diff values and adjusting both base address and size accordingly.
